fee_notes: Production Royalty: 6% of monthly Gross Commission Income (GCI), with annual cap of $3,000 per Associate (can increase to $4,000). Profit Sharing Contribution: variable based on monthly profit. Core Market Center Fee: $1,185/month (covers system-wide marketing, management, technology). Associate Access Fee: $72/month per Associate ($36 per additional team member over 20). Numerous optional fees for training, marketing premium services, and administrative functions. All fees subject to CPI adjustments starting 2028.
